course_name_en: Lighting Technology and Special Electrical Installations
prerequisites: Good foundation in circuit theory and conventional electrical installations

learning_outcomes.text: Carry out special electrical installation projects
Include Internet of Energy systems in electrical installations

syllabus_topics: Platforms and tools for IoT system development
Communication protocols and web services HTTP, MQTT
Data management, storage, processing, and visualization systems
Obtaining real energy data. Final project
Introduction. Generalities on home automation and building automation.
Home automation and electrical installation. Switchgear. Regulations.
Management areas. Functionalities. Sensors, actuators. Common elements.
The digital home. Building automation. IoT applied to home automation.

Development of home automation/building automation projects. Development phases. Environment analysis and functional specifications. Selection of sensor and actuator components. Technology selection. Programming and commissioning

assessment_methods.method: Continuous assessment (exercises and class participation) for Block 1
Continuous assessment (exercises and class participation) for Block 2

assessment_rules: For ordinary and extraordinary calls: The final grade is calculated by weighting Block 1 (30%) and Block 2 (70%). Block 1 assessment consists of 30% continuous assessment, 30% written exam, and 40% practical project. Block 2 assessment consists of 30% continuous assessment, 30% multiple-choice exam, and 40% practical assignment. For differentiated assessment: The final grade is calculated by weighting Block 1 (30%) and Block 2 (70%). Block 1 assessment consists of 50% written exam and 50% practical project. Block 2 assessment consists of 50% multiple-choice exam and 50% practical assignment.
